result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few elements appear clipped or obscured by viewport and navigation boundaries.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation, making its lower content inaccessible in the current view.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or ensure the sticky navigation does not cover the active card.

issues.description: Horizontal carousels are visibly cut off at the right edge: a category chip and the third “Fastest near you” restaurant are only partially visible, with the restaurant name clipped mid-text.
issues.suggestion: Use deliberate carousel masking or spacing, and truncate text with an ellipsis so partially visible cards look intentional.
